approaches.name: Column by column
approaches.intuition: Check position 0 in every string, then position 1, and stop at the first column where the strings disagree or one runs out.
steps: For each column `i` of the first string
Compare the character with the same column of every other string
Stop at the first mismatch or a short string

approaches.name: Shrink a running prefix
approaches.intuition: Start from the whole first string and trim it each time the next string disagrees.
steps: Trim to the shared length with each string
The candidate that survives is the answer
pitfalls: A string shorter than the candidate: stop at its length.
No common prefix returns the empty string, not an error.

talkTrackMd: Either direction is linear in the input size. Mention the early exit once the prefix is empty and that the answer can never be longer than the shortest string.
